purpose: NULL skips computed-name and pack producers. A nonnull computed nullsafe SeNd selection survives an argument producer rebinding both receiver and name aliases, while the copied reference value and sole old receiver retire in native order.
source:
<?php
class Token111P { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function old111P() {
    global $cell, $weakToken, $weakOld;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        $received = yield 'head'; $cell = 41;
        echo 'GOT|', $received === $weakToken->get(), '|', $cell === 41, '|';
        yield 'tail'; echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
    } finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token111P, '|'; }
}
function other111P() { echo 'BAD-OTHER|'; yield 'other'; }
function producer111P() {
    global $generator, $other, $methodAlias, $pack;
    echo 'PACK|'; $saved = $pack; $generator = $other; $methodAlias = 'throw'; $pack = null; return $saved;
}
function badName111P() { echo 'BAD-NAME|'; return 'send'; }
function badPack111P() { echo 'BAD-PACK|'; return []; }
$generator = null; $nullResult = $generator?->{badName111P()}(...badPack111P());
echo 'NULL|', $nullResult === null, '|';
$cell = new Token111P(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($cell); $pack = ['value' => &$cell];
$generator = old111P(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($generator); $other = other111P();
$method = 'SeNd'; $methodAlias =& $method;
echo 'CALL|'; $result = $generator?->{$method}(...producer111P());
echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $generator === $other, '|', $method === 'throw', '|', $pack === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $cell === 41, '|';
